attributes.title: 2027 IPA Spring Conference: Cognitive Processing Therapy for PTSD
attributes.summary:
The Iowa Psychological Association's 2027 Spring Conference, held April 30 and May 1, 2027, at the Graduate by Hilton in Iowa City, is a single two-day intensive training in Cognitive Processing Therapy (CPT) for PTSD. It covers CPT theory and evidence, then works step by step through the protocol, with video demonstrations, role-plays and practice in handling comorbidity and varied trauma histories. You must attend both days and bring the CPT manual (Resick et al., 2nd edition).

IPA lists 14 CEs for the workshop. The presenter is Carin M. Lefkowitz, Psy.D., of the Consortium for Defense Psychology at the Uniformed Services University.

Registration is $462 for IPA members, $385 for lifetime and early-career members, $231 for retired members, $149 for student members and $577.50 for non-members. Registration closes April 20, 2027, and the hotel room block must be booked by March 29, 2027.
